Add a refutation that addresses the strongest rival case, the digital divide, by explaining why book expansion still does more good, or by noting that the youth collection can also serve families without home internet.", "llm_assessment": "The argument rests on a plausible audience-size rationale, but it gives no data for either the collection's age or the youth share of users, and it does not engage with the competing needs of the digital option.
